title: UPI Payments
description: India's leading UPI payment apps, plus Kiwi (UPI on credit card).

themes.name: Onboarding & KYC
themes.definition: Problems signing up, verifying identity/KYC, linking a bank account or SIM, OTP/login, account blocks at registration.

themes.name: Payment failures
themes.definition: Transactions failing, stuck or pending, money debited but not credited, refunds delayed, bank-server-down errors, transaction limits.

themes.name: Customer support
themes.definition: Quality or absence of help — unresponsive support, chatbot loops, no human agent, unresolved complaints, grievance handling.

themes.name: Rewards & offers
themes.definition: Cashback, scratch cards, coupons, referral bonuses, reward fairness, missing or removed rewards.

themes.name: Trust & security
themes.definition: Fraud, scams, unauthorised debits, privacy/data concerns, account freezes, fears about safety, hidden charges or deceptive practices.

themes.name: Fees & pricing
themes.definition: Convenience fees, platform fees, charges on recharge/bills, interest or credit-card charges.

themes.name: App performance & UX
themes.definition: Crashes, lag, bugs, slow loading, confusing design, updates that broke things, battery or storage use.

themes.name: Feature requests / praise
themes.definition: Asks for a missing feature, or general praise/complaint about what the app offers without a specific problem above.

themes.name: Other / unclear
themes.definition: Too short, spam, off-topic, or fits none of the above (e.g. "good", "nice app").
